ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Given the open-loop logarithmic magnitude-frequency characteristic (broken line) of a minimum-phase system as shown in the image, calculate the phase margin \(\gamma_c\) of the system (\circ). Answer with a floating-point number to one decimal place.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a broken line of the open-loop logarithmic magnitude-frequency characteristic L0(ω). The horizontal axis is frequency ω, and the horizontal line is labeled 0 dB. The broken line crosses 0 dB at ω=2; the low-frequency segment slope is labeled -1, after ω=2 the slope becomes -2, after ω=10 the slope becomes -3, and a vertical dashed line is also drawn at ω=10 in the figure. Reasoning: According to the given method, the 0 dB crossover frequency is ωc=2 rad/s. From the slope changes, it can be judged that the system contains an integrator, and has one first-order inertial pole each at 2 rad/s and 10 rad/s. The phase of the minimum-phase system at ωc=2 is: γc = -90° - arctan(ωc/2) - arctan(ωc/10) = -90° - arctan(1) - arctan(0.2). The numerical value is -90° - 45.0° - 11.3099° = -146.3099°, which rounded to one decimal place is -146.3°.

method.method_draft: Identify ωc=2 from the 0 dB crossing. From the slopes, infer one integrator plus first-order poles at 2 and 10 rad/s. Compute γc = -90° - arctan(1) - arctan(0.2), giving approximately -146°; round to one decimal place if required.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是开环对数幅频特性 L0(ω) 的折线。横轴为频率 ω，水平线标有 0 dB。折线在 ω=2 处穿过 0 dB；低频段斜率标为 -1，ω=2 之后斜率变为 -2，ω=10 之后斜率变为 -3，图中还在 ω=10 处画有竖向虚线。

推理：按给定方法，0 dB 穿越频率为 ωc=2 rad/s。由斜率变化可判断系统包含一个积分环节，并在 2 rad/s 和 10 rad/s 处各有一个一阶惯性极点。最小相位系统在 ωc=2 处的相位为：γc = -90° - arctan(ωc/2) - arctan(ωc/10) = -90° - arctan(1) - arctan(0.2)。数值为 -90° - 45.0° - 11.3099° = -146.3099°，保留一位小数为 -146.3°。
